# Get Last Screenshots

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the last n screenshots you took.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getLastScreenshot(count: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getLastScreenshot(count: 1)
~~~~
